_comment: Per-call timeout CEILING (seconds) for every data-fetching / API / collector / renderer / subprocess call in the engine. wp_timeouts.py resolves it — an exported CTI_CALL_TIMEOUT env var first, then CTI_CALL_TIMEOUT= in the skill-root .env (or intel_engine/.env), then this file — and exports the result to child processes; wp_common installs a process-wide urllib.request.urlopen floor at that value and every subprocess runner floors its bound to it. 1800 = 30 min: each call runs up to this long, then times out and the run moves on to the next. Raise it for very slow links, lower it to fail faster. NOT applied to raw DNS/TLS/JARM resolution probes (those keep their short fail-fast bounds by design).
